"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT

Post-Apocalyptic Survival MMORPG

Inspired by Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest

Create a 3D open-world post-apocalyptic survival MMORPG inspired by the general gameplay mechanics and atmosphere of Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest.

The game takes place in a dangerous post-apocalyptic world where players must survive, explore abandoned locations, fight zombies, collect resources, craft equipment, build shelters, and develop their characters.

1. WORLD @COMMENT_BODY@ ENVIRONMENT

- Large open-world post-apocalyptic map.
- Abandoned cities, destroyed buildings, forests, military bases, underground facilities, and wastelands.
- Dynamic day and night cycles.
- Weather systems including rain, fog, storms, and radiation zones.
- Lootable containers, abandoned houses, safes, and hidden locations.
- Different areas with different zombie levels and resource availability.

2. SURVIVAL SYSTEM

- Hunger, thirst, health, stamina, and radiation systems.
- Collect food, water, medicine, materials, and equipment.
- Craft weapons, armor, tools, and survival equipment.
- Build and upgrade personal shelters.
- Equipment durability and repair systems.

3. ZOMBIE SYSTEM

Create different zombie types:

- Common Zombies.
- Fast Zombies.
- Armored Zombies.
- Mutated Zombies.
- Elite Zombies.
- Boss Zombies.

Zombie drops may include:

- GOLD.
- Crafting materials.
- Food and medical supplies.
- Weapons and equipment.
- Rare blueprints.

Higher-level zombies should have better potential loot.

4. ECONOMY SYSTEM – GOLD ONLY

Completely remove all real-money purchases and cash-based microtransactions.

Replace all premium currencies with a single in-game currency called GOLD.

GOLD SOURCES:

- Killing zombies.
- Looting abandoned buildings.
- Searching safes and supply boxes.
- Exploring military facilities.
- Defeating elite and boss zombies.
- Completing missions and challenges.

GOLD USAGE:

- Purchasing weapons and armor.
- Purchasing crafting materials.
- Purchasing backpacks and equipment.
- Purchasing cosmetics.
- Unlocking upgrades.
- Trading with other players.

IMPORTANT RULES:

- No real-money purchases.
- No premium currency.
- No paid loot boxes.
- No subscriptions.
- No cash-based upgrades.
- Every purchasable item must be obtainable through gameplay.
- GOLD must be the only purchasing currency.

5. BACKPACK @COMMENT_BODY@ INVENTORY SYSTEM

Implement a backpack progression system with these EXACT capacities:

Backpack Tier| Capacity
Basic Backpack| 35 Slots
Medium Backpack| 70 Slots
Advanced Backpack| 140 Slots
Military Backpack| 280 Slots
Elite Backpack| 560 Slots

IMPORTANT RULES:

- Each backpack tier must have exactly twice the capacity of the previous tier.
- Do not change the specified capacity values.
- Backpack upgrades must be obtainable through crafting, exploration, looting, or GOLD purchases.
- Higher-tier backpacks must have visually distinct designs.
- Inventory must support item stacking, sorting, and categorization.
- Include quick-access slots and equipment slots.
- Include personal storage chests.
- Optimize inventory performance even with 560 slots.

6. EQUIPMENT @COMMENT_BODY@ PROGRESSION

- Multiple weapon categories.
- Different armor tiers.
- Equipment rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary.
- Weapon upgrades and modifications.
- Crafting blueprints.
- Player experience and leveling.
- Unlockable skills and abilities.
- Equipment progression should reward exploration and survival.

7. MULTIPLAYER

- Persistent online multiplayer world.
- Player interaction and cooperation.
- Trading between players using GOLD.
- Cooperative zombie hunting.
- Shared missions and boss encounters.
- Optional PvP zones.
- Player shelters and social interaction.

8. GAMEPAD @COMMENT_BODY@ CONTROLLER SUPPORT

Implement complete native gamepad support for Android devices.

IMPORTANT: The gamepad experience must work like traditional console games, especially the control systems found in Resident Evil and other classic PlayStation-style games.

AUTOMATIC GAMEPAD DETECTION:

- Automatically detect a connected Bluetooth or USB gamepad.
- Provide a simple Enable Gamepad Mode option.
- Once activated, automatically switch the entire game interface to controller mode.
- No manual button mapping required.
- No complicated configuration.
- Automatically recognize supported controller layouts.

FULL GAMEPAD CONTROL:
Every gameplay feature must be accessible using only a gamepad.

Include controller support for:

- Character movement.
- Camera movement.
- Running and sprinting.
- Jumping and crouching.
- Combat and aiming.
- Weapon switching.
- Reloading.
- Interacting with objects.
- Opening doors and containers.
- Looting.
- Inventory management.
- Equipment management.
- Crafting.
- Building and upgrading shelters.
- Map navigation.
- Quest and mission menus.
- Trading.
- Settings and pause menus.

CONTROLLER LAYOUT:
Use a familiar PlayStation-style layout:

- Left Analog Stick: Character movement.
- Right Analog Stick: Camera movement.
- X / Cross: Jump or confirm, depending on context.
- Circle: Cancel, dodge, or back.
- Square: Interact, reload, or contextual action.
- Triangle: Inventory or equipment shortcut.
- L1 / R1: Switch equipment or quick-access items.
- L2 / R2: Aim and attack or shoot.
- L3: Sprint.
- R3: Camera or target-related action.
- D-Pad: Quick item selection.
- Options: Pause menu.
- Touchpad / View: Map or additional interface.

Allow contextual button prompts depending on the current gameplay situation.

GAMEPAD INTERFACE:

- Automatically display controller button icons instead of touchscreen button icons.
- All menus must support analog-stick navigation and D-Pad navigation.
- Inventory and crafting menus must be fully navigable with a controller.
- Add visual feedback when selecting items.
- Maintain consistent button prompts throughout the game.

AUTOMATIC INPUT SWITCHING:

- When Gamepad Mode is enabled, prioritize gamepad input.
- Hide unnecessary touchscreen controls.
- Restore touchscreen controls when Gamepad Mode is disabled.
- Allow switching between touchscreen and gamepad modes.
- Support reconnecting a disconnected controller without losing gameplay progress.

IMPORTANT:
The player must be able to play the entire game from start to finish using only a gamepad, without ever needing to touch the screen for gameplay or menu navigation.

9. LANGUAGE @COMMENT_BODY@ LOCALIZATION SYSTEM

The original and default game language must be ENGLISH.

Create a complete language selection system accessible through the main menu and settings.

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES:

1. English (Default).
2. Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
3. Korean (한국어).
4. Chinese (简体中文).
5. Malay (Bahasa Melayu).
6. Portuguese (Português).
7. Spanish (Español).

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS:

- English must be the original source language for all game content.
- Players can freely change the language through Settings.
- Changing languages must not reset game progress.
- All menus, buttons, descriptions, missions, quests, dialogues, notifications, item names, crafting instructions, and system messages must be translated.
- Include translated subtitles and dialogue text.
- Use appropriate fonts and character rendering for every supported language.
- Ensure Korean and Chinese characters display correctly.
- Avoid untranslated text and mixed-language interfaces.
- Save the player's language preference automatically.

IMPORTANT:
Use a centralized localization system so additional languages can be added in future updates without rewriting the game's interface or code.

10. GRAPHICS @COMMENT_BODY@ GAMEPLAY

- Realistic 3D graphics.
- Dark post-apocalyptic atmosphere.
- Detailed environments and abandoned structures.
- Immersive zombie animations.
- Realistic weapon handling and survival interactions.
- Third-person camera with optional first-person perspective.
- Mobile-friendly joystick controls.
- Full gamepad compatibility.
- Optimized performance for Android devices.

11. FINAL DEVELOPMENT REQUIREMENTS

Build a complete and playable survival MMORPG featuring:

- Open-world exploration.
- Zombie combat.
- Resource gathering.
- Looting system.
- Crafting system.
- Shelter building.
- Character progression.
- Complete equipment system.
- Five backpack tiers with exact specified capacities.
- Fully functional GOLD economy.
- No real-money transactions.
- Persistent online multiplayer.
- Complete native gamepad support.
- Automatic gamepad detection and input switching.
- Full controller-based gameplay and menu navigation.
- English as the default language.
- Six additional selectable languages.

Use original assets, characters, maps, names, and code. Take inspiration from general survival gameplay concepts without copying proprietary content.

Prioritize a stable, optimized, scalable, and enjoyable mobile gaming experience.

The final product must feel like a complete console-style survival game that can also be played comfortably on Android touchscreen devices.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable post-apocalyptic survival MMORPG prototype inspired by general survival-game mechanics, with a mobile-friendly interface and gamepad support.

## Requirements
- User requested open-world exploration, survival stats, zombies/combat, looting, crafting, shelter building, progression, multiplayer/trading, and a GOLD-only economy without real-money purchases.
- Backpack tiers must have exact capacities: Basic 35, Medium 70, Advanced 140, Military 280, Elite 560.
- Support touchscreen and gamepad gameplay, plus English default and Indonesian, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Malay, Portuguese, and Spanish localization.
- Use original content and assets; prioritize mobile-friendly performance.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser-based playable preview in one HTML file, using Canvas-rendered 2D top-down gameplay rather than a full 3D persistent online MMORPG.
- Progress is saved in browser localStorage; multiplayer/server persistence and full production-level features are not implemented.
- Used original game identity “ASHFALL” and original Greyhollow setting.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable prototype with movement, zombie combat, loot gathering, survival meters, GOLD rewards, mission progression, crafting, trading, shelter actions, inventory, and local saves.
- Added exact backpack capacity table, touch joystick/buttons, basic gamepad polling, modal menus, and seven language selection options with centralized string tables.
- Added settings, equipment, map, missions, shelter, and trade UI.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully.
- Opened in browser and saved a viewport screenshot.

### Active
- Review browser console errors and fix any runtime issues.
- Test game interactions, responsive layout, localization, and controller/menu behavior.

### Blocked
- The request for a complete 3D online MMORPG is represented by a 2D single-player browser prototype; real multiplayer/persistent online systems and native Android support remain outside the implementation.

## Next Move
1. Inspect browser console output for the two reported errors and fix them.
2. Exercise core gameplay and menus in browser; update the screenshot if necessary.
3. Check `git status` and report implementation scope/limitations clearly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire playable game prototype and styles/scripts.
- `screenshots/ashfall.jpg`: latest captured gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context

## Objective
- Build a playable post-apocalyptic survival MMORPG prototype with mobile-friendly controls and gamepad support.

- Implemented “ASHFALL,” a self-contained browser-based 2D top-down playable preview in one HTML file, rather than a production 3D online MMORPG.

- Build a playable post-apocalyptic survival MMORPG prototype with mobile-friendly controls and gamepad support.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, survival stats, zombies/combat, looting, crafting, shelter building, progression, multiplayer/trading, and a GOLD-only economy without real-money purchases.

- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed untracked project files including `index.html` and `screenshots/`.
